scenarios.name: Cancel a staged model-state suppression change

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State
the user sets the extrusion to Suppress in Primary and Capture State and Compute in Copy State through the model-state table
The MCAD Software has a part with an extrusion suppressed in Primary and Capture State
the extrusion is computed in Copy State
the user opens the model-state table
the extrusion column shows Suppress for Primary and Capture State
the extrusion column shows Compute for Copy State
the user edits the Primary extrusion cell
the cell offers Compute and Suppress
the user cancels and reopens the model-state table
the Primary extrusion cell displays Suppress
the other two extrusion values are unchanged
